title: Transcendence of God
definition: The transcendence of God means that God is infinitely above and beyond creation in majesty, being, glory, and perfection.
summary: God is exalted above all creation and cannot be reduced to creaturely limits.
christFocus: Jesus reveals the transcendent God while also bringing sinners near through grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's transcendence means He is not part of creation, limited by creation, or measurable by creaturely standards. He is infinitely above all things in glory, wisdom, holiness, and power.

This doctrine produces humility. God is not small, manageable, or answerable to human pride. His ways are higher than ours.

Yet the transcendent God has made Himself known and has come near in Christ. His greatness does not make Him distant from His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often shrink God down to what they can understand or control. The transcendence of God matters because it restores reverence, awe, and humility.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Approach God with awe. Let His greatness humble your pride and strengthen your trust when you do not understand His ways.
